title: Change Value to Reference

solutions.title: One rider record, trips that point at it
solutions.tradeoff: Every trip now depends on the directory that owns its rider, so a rider can no longer be corrected by editing a trip in isolation - a real loss of independence for code that used to treat each trip as a fully self-contained record.

reviewFocus: Does bookTrip in the solution still copy the rider's fields onto the trip anywhere, or does the trip genuinely hold the same Rider object the directory owns?
Does correctRiderPhone touch anything beyond the one rider record in the directory - if it reaches into trips directly, the point of the refactoring has been missed.
Read the comment naming what tests/rider-trips.spec.ts deliberately does not assert - does it still hold, or did a later step quietly make it false?
Is Rider still exported with mutable name/phone/email fields, or did the refactor accidentally make it a readonly value - which would be drill-09-04's answer to the wrong problem?

Compare against drill-09-04: does this solution's Rider earn reference semantics by needing exactly one owner that updates are visible through - the opposite of drill-09-04's Fare, which is safe to duplicate freely?
